items.title: Albert Nicholas Interview, 1972-06-26
items.q: That's when Russell lost the band. Joe Glazer took over. I guess he made big money. He did.

ctx.x: Joe Glazer took the band over.
That's when Russell lost the band. Joe Glazer took over. I guess he made big money. He did.
He made millions for Joe. We knew he made millions for Joe Glazer.
